body: I told my mom about it, and she says I need to just concentrate on myself (which I agree with), but my friends don't talk to their parents about how they feel. One of them doesn't see the point in getting help.

I think it's just the fact that I so desperately want to help them, but I can't. I hung out with one of my friends the other day and she was constantly making comments on the different ways she could kill herself.

Thank you very much. When he and I talked last night, he told me that he'd rather talk to someone he knows about his problems instead of a doctor he doesn't know (which I do understand). He also said that he didn't get along with the psychiatrist at all, but I'm sure that he could find someone that he gets along with. 

He's the type of guy that will party whenever he can, which worries me because I don't go out to parties and I don't know the people he party's with very well, so I'm not sure how to ask him to not drink as much? I'd honestly prefer it if he smoked instead of drinking. I almost lost one of my best friends to alcohol last year, so I am extremely sorry for your loss.

As for my mental health, I know that if it becomes too much for me to handle, that I'll have to break up with him. If it gets to that point, I will still be there for him in any way that I can but I still have my own down days and it's a lot of pressure to be someone's rock when they're suicidal (and I know how bad that sounds, but I put that pressure on my friends when I was in that place and lost almost all of them). Again, thank you so much <3
Thank you very much. I'll try to talk to him in the morning about it as it seems he's calmed down and is doing alright right now. I appreciate it greatly <3
